inputAssessment: All groups/checks have identical recorded final source/test inventories with no changes during or after execution. The lifecycle process has one explicit retained failure; a separate same-input focused retry must pass precisely that case, and distinct passed names are checked. This is aggregate development evidence, not a claim that every original command exited zero. Config files are included in the final binding. Complete workspace rebuilt before tests. Bundled source-map source bytes match current source and vendor files. Historical control SQL 1..44 is unchanged. Runner source and persistent schema and dependencies are unchanged.
scope: Local development only: actual file-backed control/Runner/data Workers, exact candidate preview management HTTP, owner intents, real data files, original ACK recovery and stop, bounded redacted history and membership checks. Container/network/OCI and physical custody/fences remain explicit fixtures. No actual model/OIDC/Linux/gVisor/physical provider or formal successor preserve/replace acceptance. No default physical authority.
actualChecks: Actual HTTP defaults new dataset/start intents off, keeps current-member reads, distinguishes viewer/owner and current selected policy, pins policy map against later caller mutation and rejects absent Input API at host composition.

Actual file-backed control Worker plus HTTP records dataset/start/stop owner intents. Each injected committed ACK loss survives Worker reopen and new-policy selection removal with the original body/key/If-Match, producing one original identity.

Actual local application SQLite preparation and a business write compose with independently advanced controlled preview start/stop. Original stop preserves database bytes and creates no accepted Release or project pointer.
Strict body/query schemas, Idempotency-Key, If-Match, Origin, original-body conflicts, unavailable unprepared dataset and foreign resource/candidate paths reject without extra resources.

Three actual prepared datasets paginate one item at a time through stable original cursors; GET never starts previews. The response omits paths, backend/Runner/instance/endpoint and internal request/proof. A membership removal after the writer snapshot is caught before protected HTTP response.

Malformed stop confirmation or stale impact hash cannot create a stop decision. An explicitly inserted legacy Release ownership projection disables stop and the writer rejects it. This projection is not T5 or successor acceptance evidence.
reproduction: validation-driver.mjs records exact build/type/lint/contracts and consumer/domain/lifecycle commands, complete input inventories and stdout/stderr SHA; binding-driver.mjs verifies final bytes, maps, unchanged old SQL/Runner/dependencies.
limits: Source candidate/Git/OCI and container facts remain explicit fixtures; Release ownership is an explicit legacy projection, not T5.
No new React management page, enterprise identity, physical Linux/gVisor or complete successor preserve/replace acceptance.
Configured preview policy selection is not proof of a configured or healthy backend/gateway. Consumers are independently installed by trusted composition.

An inherited real-time readiness case failed under concurrent load and passed only after a focused same-input retry; original nonzero process and timing diagnostic are retained. No test assertion or product freshness was changed.
